user.title: Mertik Maxitrol Fireplace
user.description: Enter a name and the IP address of the myfire WiFi box, then choose the temperature sensor and thermostatic settings. Each fireplace has its own settings.

data.name: Fireplace name
data.host: IP address of the WiFi box
data.temperature_sensor: Temperature sensor for thermostatic control (Mertik handset uses the fireplace's own)
data.low_threshold: Low heat threshold (degrees C below setpoint)
data.high_threshold: Full heat threshold (degrees C below setpoint, must be greater than Low)
data.default_temperature: Default target temperature (°C, applied each time the fire is switched on)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Mertik Maxitrol
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address of your fireplace WiFi box.

data.host: IP address of the WiFi box
data.low_threshold: Low heat threshold (degrees C below setpoint)
data.high_threshold: Full heat threshold (degrees C below setpoint, must be greater than Low)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the fireplace WiFi box. Check the IP address and that the device is powered on and connected to your network.
error.invalid_thresholds: Thresholds must be positive numbers, and the Low threshold must be less than the Full threshold.
error.invalid_default_temp: Default target temperature must be between 5 and 36 °C.

cannot_connect.title: Cannot connect to Mertik Maxitrol fireplace
cannot_connect.description: Home Assistant cannot reach the fireplace WiFi box at {host}. Check that the device is powered on and connected to your network. If the IP address has changed, use **Reconfigure** to update it.

receiver_lost.title: {name}: WiFi box cannot reach the fireplace (F43)
receiver_lost.description:
The myfire WiFi box is online but has lost its radio link to the fireplace receiver, so Home Assistant's commands cannot reach the fire. The handset may still work.

Switch the fireplace's power off for 30 seconds and back on. If the MyFire app still shows F43 "No receiver connected", re-pair the WiFi box with the receiver following the box's instructions. This alert clears by itself once the link is restored.

not_responding.title: {name}: WiFi box is not responding
not_responding.description:
The myfire WiFi box has not answered any command for 30 seconds, so Home Assistant cannot control the fire. The MyFire app usually shows a loss of signal at the same time.

Operating the fire with the handset often restores the link. If not, switch the fireplace's power off for 30 seconds and back on, and check the receiver's power supply or batteries. This alert clears by itself once the box replies again.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to the fireplace. Check the IP address and that the device is powered on and connected to your network.

ignition_not_allowed.message: Ignition is not allowed while the fireplace is shutting down. Try again in a few seconds.

state.f03: F03 – Thermocouple wiring or ON/OFF switch fault
state.f04: F04 – Ignition sequence malfunction (wait 1 min, retry)
state.f10: F10 – Main burner ignition failure (2nd thermocouple)
state.f44: F44 – Handset not in range or low battery

init.title: Fireplace Options
init.description: Choose the temperature sensor used for thermostatic control and adjust the heating thresholds.

data.temperature_sensor: Temperature sensor (leave blank to use the fireplace handset)
data.low_threshold: Low heat threshold (degrees C below setpoint)
data.high_threshold: Full heat threshold (degrees C below setpoint, must be greater than Low)
data.default_temperature: Default target temperature (°C, applied each time the fire is switched on)
data.hysteresis: Hysteresis (degrees C either side of each threshold)
data.light_with_fire: Switch the fire's light on when the fire is switched on

error.invalid_thresholds: Thresholds must be positive numbers, and the Low threshold must be less than the Full threshold.
error.invalid_temp_step: Setpoint step must be a positive number.
error.invalid_default_temp: Default target temperature must be between 5 and 36 °C.
error.invalid_hysteresis: Hysteresis must be 0 or more, and twice it must fit within the Low band (Low threshold) and the Medium band (Full threshold minus Low threshold).
